column1: # A player's Combat Achievement tier from their completed tasks per tier (Dylan, 2026-10-27, B274 step 6).
# One copy of the rule's answers: the plugin's CaTierCasesTest, killclog-api's and the site's tests run these rows.
# Easy through Master unlock by points (a task is worth 1 to 6 by its tier, wherever it was done); each tier's line is
# every task in it and below, times their points, against the game's current task counts. Grandmaster is every task
# done against those counts. The plugin reads the counts from the game (CaCatalog); killclog.com and killclog-api read
# them from the provider's totals, which come from the game. A release that adds tasks moves every line above it.
